data.title: 橘美花莉 · 自家卧房的青梅竹马自持
data.description: 成年橘美花莉盖着棉质被单在自家床上休息，栗棕长发散在枕边。她望向床头柜上的童年合照，暖色夜灯照亮相框与被单。
data.action: 盖着棉质被单躺在床上，侧头望向床头合照，栗棕长发散在枕边
data.promptProse: In her quiet bedroom at night bathed in soft amber light from a bedside lamp, Mikari rests under crisp cotton sheets with her hair spread across the pillow, looking gently over at a framed childhood photo on the nightstand.
data.nsfwProse: Unclothed beneath the tucked cotton bedsheet, her bare shoulders and collarbones emerge cleanly above the folded edge.
data.animaCaption: Lying nude beneath a soft cotton sheet pulled neatly up over her chest with her hair fanned across the pillow, she gazes fondly toward the framed childhood photo on her nightstand in the warm amber glow of the bedside lamp.
